title: No Entry Desert Vision
description: A surreal desert landscape features a red octagonal 'NO ENTRY' sign with a censored bar in the foreground. In the sky, a large yellow sun with radiating beams sits above a floating bald man's head with wide eyes and an open mouth, stitched marks on his scalp, black lines radiating outward.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with rolling red and orange sand dunes under a cracked blue sky. A large yellow sun with brick-like rays shines above a floating bald man's head with wide fearful eyes, open mouth, and stitches on his scalp. Black lines radiate from his head. In the foreground, a red octagonal NO ENTRY sign with a black censored bar across the top, set against a green tiled path with yellow and blue flowers. Artistic painted style with visible brushwork.
